note: 1901 households whose house the record already holds, either by number or by a name it carries. Houses that already hold a 1901 household are deliberately absent — Ravine House, 23 and Lenton House on Lenton Road, and 13 Pelham Crescent — so nothing doubles up. Houses whose name the record cannot place are parked in 1901_unnumbered_houses.json instead. Surnames are carried down from the head where the relationship column makes them certain; birthplaces are written out in full. Entries that collided with somebody the record already held under a fuller forename — Alice May Parr against Alice Mary, Constance Marjorie Smith against Constance M. — now carry that person's number. The importer matches names letter for letter and was making a second record of each of them on every run; a number matches whatever the spelling, survives a merge, and cannot mint a new person.
source: 1901 census — transcribed by A. Hagues from the enumerators' pages
